# Louigie Caminoy

> Multidisciplinary technopreneur and software engineer based in Metro Manila, Philippines. Co-founder & CTO of iSkolar. Builds across development, design, and product, with a focus on blockchain and AI.

Key facts:

- Currently Co-founder & CTO at iSkolar (scholarship application and management platform, blockchain + AI).
- Also AI Lead at AWS Learning Club - Heron, mentoring developers on LLMs and AI engineering.
- Studying BS Computer Science at University of Makati (expected 2027).
- Focus areas: blockchain development, systems architecture, technical leadership, system design, project management, full stack development, AI engineering.
- Contact: louigiecads143@gmail.com
